question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the left of J. Only four people sit between J and K. Only three people sit to the right of O. I sits to the immediate left of L. P is not an immediate neighbour of O. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
